description: Reviewer-response evaluation of robust all-service evidence correction on frozen TrainTicket and AIOps2022 cohorts

evidence.fusion_weight_status: Shared prespecified reviewer-response setting; sensitivity is descriptive and does not replace it

rules: Frozen incident splits and labels are never modified.
The main configuration is fixed before this output directory is evaluated; test sensitivity grids are descriptive only.
History-type holdout removes the held type and different-type incidents sharing its overlap groups from base training, validation selection, evidence training, and training topology.

History-type holdout retains shared pre-window numeric calibration that is not refit and may include telemetry overlapping a neighboring incident; it is not an end-to-end row-level preprocessing holdout.
Missing-observation views are deterministic transformations of test telemetry and never change ground truth.
No causal edge correctness is claimed without independent path labels.
All negative LLM and robustness results are retained.
The test cohorts were inspected in earlier project iterations; this is an exploratory controlled supplement, not an untouched confirmatory test.
